items.reason: Describes the same off-by-one totalPages calculation that enables navigation to an empty page when the member count is an exact multiple of the limit.
Describes the same unchecked client-supplied limit allowing oversized pages and negative-limit errors. The additional offset validation concern does not change the match.
Describes the same totalPages overcount for exact multiples of the page size, leaving Next enabled on the real last page.
Describes the same floor-plus-one pagination error that creates a phantom empty last page.
Describes the same public members page truncation caused by the new default limit of 50 without public pagination controls.
Describes the same extra page for an exact multiple of the limit, allowing Next to request offset equal to user_count.
